versions.changelog: Retire global entry blocks; the protocol now loads only on explicit skill requests, with setup.py kept for legacy block cleanup
Simplify the runtime protocol: current.md plus history.md, no owner/ack/hop or forced task branches
One global skill serves all repositories; legacy repositories migrate safely at startup
Move the ledger script into the runtime skill directory: it now installs to .agents/skills/handoff/ledger.sh; update migrates a legacy tools/ledger.sh automatically.
Fix installer symlink escape: reject install when .agents (or a path under it) is a symlink, preventing writes outside the target repository.
Improve handoff completion, compression, installer version handling, and ledger task matching.
Declare the two-layer scope of the package
Verify tag-triggered publish chain under the renamed agent-handoff-skill slug
Require consent before reading session history
Confirm annotated tag changelog reaches ClawHub
Remove unsafe policy exception and require mutating-mode consent
Fix bundle integrity and declare runtime requirements
